mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.dept_id, p.category, p.semester_id, p.quota, p.hired, p.hourly_wage, p.work_content, p.work_location, p.contact_person, p.contact_phone, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.publish_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.create_user, p.update_user, d.name as dept_name, ifnull((select sd.item_text from sys_dict sd where sd.dict_code = 'position_category' and sd.item_value = p.category limit 1), p.category) as category_name, (ifnull(p.quota, 0) - ifnull(p.hired, 0)) as remain_quota
mapper.insert: insert into position (name, dept_id, category, semester_id, quota, hired, hourly_wage, work_content, work_location, contact_person, contact_phone, status, reject_reason, publish_time, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{deptId}, #{category}, #{semesterId}, #{quota}, #{hired}, #{hourlyWage}, #{workContent}, #{workLocation}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{publishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update position set status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select
from position p left join dept d on p.dept_id = d.id where p.id = #{id}
